reviewContext.note: No manifest supplied for this scope; reviewed disk-only per the explicit file list. Round-6 verification of round-5 FIND-001/FIND-002 fixes plus full money-integrity / security / no-human re-audit.

evidence.description: do_settle takes the amount ONLY from record-earn's 'VERIFIED +N USDC' stdout (sed at run.sh:130); never from ANICCA_ARGS/GIG_AMOUNT. GIG_AMOUNT is used only as a bid proposal price (bid-run.mjs:28), not as a recorded earn.

earn is the record-earn value; tx attached only from a real external log (representativeExternalTx) or the FOUNDER_TEST-gated GIG_SETTLE_TX seam; otherwise no_tx is flagged and the line under-counts rather than fabricating.

Round-5 FIND-001 gap CLOSED: the real-chain extraction SUCCESS branch is now executed via the FOUNDER_TEST-gated GIG_RAW_LOGS_JSON seam — external-log->tx (test:22), founder+SHARED-only->null (test:30), most-recent-external-skipping-trailing-SHARED (test:36), wrong-recipient->null (test:43).
Null/no-tx branch covered: real path with unreachable RPC (BASE_RPC_URL http://127.0.0.1:1) -> representativeExternalTx returns null -> honest no_tx under-count, not profitable.

Regression check confirmed: dropping the SHARED exclusion (myWallets) makes settle-tx.test.mjs:30 and :36 both fail (a SHARED transfer would be returned as external); dropping the founder-self exclusion makes :30 fail (0xself returned). Both exclusions are genuinely guarded.

Recipient (topics[2]) and topic0 (Transfer sig) are re-verified per log, server filter never trusted; payer excluded against {wallet} U SHARED. A Transfer log only exists for a mined+successful tx, so status 0x1 is sound (settle-write.mjs:47).

classifyEarnResult locates the line by line.wake===WAKE_ID (never last-line) and applies isProfitable; settle.test.mjs:59-68 drives the REAL function with the correct arg order (wakeId, ledgerPath, isProfitableFn) and asserts profitable===true and earnLine.earn_usdc===12.5.
isProfitable demands tx && status==='0x1' && net_usdc>0 && external===true && non-swap source; the settle line satisfies all five only when a real tx is attached.

Both test seams follow identical FOUNDER_TEST gating discipline as record-earn's seams. The I/O boundary is the injection point (raw eth_getLogs), so the parse/exclude/select logic under test is byte-identical to prod.
bid/deliver hardcode earn_usdc:0 and never emit external or tx, so the always-safe anti-shortcut invariant (only record-earn counts) holds end-to-end.

Child env is scrubPrivateKeys(process.env) (strips *_WALLET_KEY/_PRIVATE_KEY/_PRIV_KEY) + redactPrivateKeyPatterns on output; KEY-ISOLATION holds. contract.test.mjs:64-67 asserts the planted key never appears in stdout/stderr.

ANICCA_ARGS is the ONLY model-controlled channel and is parsed into mode/jobId/amount/proposal only — it cannot set FOUNDER_TEST, GIG_SETTLE_TX, or GIG_RAW_LOGS_JSON. grep across runtime/ + skills/ shows no prod path sets any of the three seam vars (only __tests__ and prior review docs). Both seams are unreachable in prod.

auditNoHuman scans every executable file for stdin/prompt/read-p/ask-human patterns; the test proves the auditor catches planted human steps and that the live slot has zero. Loop spawns run.sh with stdin ignored (run-skill.mjs:44).
